newsitem.title: PERU: Lima stocks rise on optimism over economy.
newsitem.headline: Lima stocks rise on optimism over economy.

text.p: Peruvian shares rose slightly Monday on investor optimism over the nation's improving economic prospects, brokers said.
They predicted, however, profit-taking may affect the market Tuesday, particularly in the mining and industrial sectors that have gained in recent sessions.
"There is confidence," said Hernando Pastor, of T&J brokerage. "However, there are shares which have experienced constant rises that could correct themselves on Tuesday."
The General Index edged up 0.54 percent to 1,578.79 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index rose 0.45 percent to 2,259.07.
In a total of 1,387 trades, volume was estimated at 24.8 million soles ($9.42 million) as 35 stocks rose, 17 fell and 38 were stable.

Biggest advancers included miner Morococha, up 2.25 percent to 1.82 soles on 260,793 shares, fellow miner Buenaventura, which gained 1.56 percent to 20.21 soles on 21,444 stocks, and benchmark Telefonica del Peru, up 0.34 percent to 5.82 soles on 1.23 million shares.
Telefonica accounted for 28.27 percent of total trade.
